mapper.select: SELECT option_id, option_name, option_name_en, option_price, option_image, option_is_available, is_visible FROM options ORDER BY option_id ASC
SELECT option_id, option_name, option_name_en, option_price, option_image, option_is_available, is_visible FROM options WHERE option_id = #{optionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO options ( option_name, option_name_en, option_price, option_image, option_is_available, is_visible ) VALUES ( #{optionName}, #{optionNameEn}, #{optionPrice}, #{optionImage}, #{optionIsAvailable}, #{isVisible} )
mapper.update: UPDATE options SET option_name = #{optionName}, option_name_en = #{optionNameEn}, option_price = #{optionPrice}, option_image = #{optionImage}, option_is_available = #{optionIsAvailable} WHERE option_id = #{optionId}
UPDATE options SET is_visible = false, option_is_available = false WHERE option_id = #{optionId}
UPDATE options SET is_visible = true, option_is_available = true WHERE option_id = #{optionId}
